title: Duties of the policy board.
bodyText:
PART IV. SPECIFICATIONS

The policy board shall adopt rules governing the preparation, maintenance, and content of specifications for goods, services, and construction required by the State.
bodyHtml:
PART IV.  SPECIFICATIONS

 

     §103D-401  Duties of the policy board.  The policy board shall adopt rules governing the preparation, maintenance, and content of specifications for goods, services, and construction required by the State. [L Sp 1993, c 8, pt of §2; am L 1997, c 352, §23]
